name: Crypto Tax Calculator
description: Calculates cryptocurrency tax obligations by tracking cost basis and transaction history across multiple chains and exchanges.
author: JackTheGit

fetchWalletTransactions.description: Scans on-chain EVM wallet histories (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism) via Blockscout endpoints.

fetchCexTransactions.description: Pulls historical trade logs from Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, and 100+ CEXs via ccxt.

calculateCryptoGains.description: Runs FIFO/LIFO lot matching with short-term vs. long-term capital gains splits and ERC-20 token support.
